metadata.description: Claude Code skills by Vipul Chauhan.

plugins.name: ai-toolkit
plugins.description: Skills for building new products: a design system builder, a project planner that splits a spec into phases for a coding agent, a doc trimmer, a doc reviewer, a React and Next.js code skill, a Node.js skill, a Python skill (Django and FastAPI) and a Julia skill that write backend code to fixed rules and check it, stopping at the API and database boundaries, a UI developer that builds from a design system's tokens, and a skill-runner subagent that runs named skills in the background and writes a report file.
